component.name: OpenDial
component.summary: Microsoft Surface Dial support for Linux

description.p: OpenDial turns the Microsoft Surface Dial into a programmable controller on Linux: press and hold for a radial tool menu, turn to adjust volume, scroll, zoom, undo, brightness and media, or define your own tools with separate clockwise, counter-clockwise and click actions.

ul.li: Radial menu with built-in and custom tools, folders and icons
Per-app profiles that switch automatically with the focused window
Haptic feedback, sensitivity, acceleration and handedness
Macros, value tools and approved command/D-Bus/OSC actions
Plugin API for apps such as Krita, a CLI and a D-Bus API
